Crime & Law · India

Multiple road accidents across India result in injuries

Several road accidents have occurred across India, leading to multiple injuries. In Jammu and Kashmir's Reasi district, a bus carrying CISF personnel overturned, injuring nine personnel and the driver. Three CISF personnel with serious injuries were moved to a Jammu hospital, while seven others with minor injuries were treated locally. Separately, a sleeper bus crashed into a trailer on the Yamuna Expressway, killing four people and injuring 19. Other incidents include a bus overturning in Telangana's Wanaparthy district, injuring 15, and an accident in Poonch, Jammu and Kashmir, injuring 10 labourers.
